stem: A retailer's fraud-detection system must react to a suspicious card charge within seconds of the charge occurring and cannot wait for a scheduled job to run.

choices.text: Schedule an hourly batch export of transactions into the data lake
Ingest each transaction as a streaming record the moment it occurs
Buffer transactions for fifteen minutes before loading them as a micro-batch
Load the day's transactions in one batch once daily traffic is low

rationale: Streaming ingestion delivers each record continuously, within seconds of it occurring, matching a seconds-level freshness requirement. An hourly batch export collects data over an hour before loading it, far slower than the stated need. A fifteen-minute micro-batch is closer to real time than a full batch job but still buffers well beyond a within-seconds requirement. A once-daily batch load is the slowest option and cannot support a same-second fraud reaction at all.
